question_4_is_the_reference_item_exact_t.label: INFERRED
question_4_is_the_reference_item_exact_t.statement: The exact text of a NON-TARGET reference item is not a necessary safety signal for establishing the Save All candidate. The signals that actually prevent a wrong click are: (a) the menu surface was affirmatively detected on THIS frame; (b) the target string is exact and must occupy exactly one OCR row inside the verified popup bbox; (c) that row must be the middle row (3rd of exactly five, in the reference order) with neighbors still matching 修改相簿名稱-ish / 刪除相簿-ish within one substituted character; (d) the candidate must sit in the row's safe interior, clear of row edges and both neighbor rows, inside the addressable region. A single-glyph misread of a neighbor row changes none of these facts about where the target is.
why_the_v7_strictness_was_not_required: the v7 strict check never influenced row geometry or candidate computation; it only decided whether to continue at all
row identity of the target comes from the target's own exact OCR text plus row clustering, not from the other rows
the position constraint (target must be the 3rd of five rows in reference order) already detects a wrong menu that merely happens to contain the same target string elsewhere

residual_unknown.label: UNKNOWN
residual_unknown.statement: No formal proof exists that no other LINE (or system) popup could present the same five-row shape with 儲存全部 as the middle row; the safety argument is a bounded risk reduction, not a proof.
bounding_measures: the tolerance is exactly one substituted character per non-target row, length-equal only, no insertions/deletions, target tolerance 0
item count must be exactly five in the reference order; two or more damaged characters in the same row refuse
the candidate must pass the popup-shape rule, band-in-bbox rule, neighbor-separation rule and the placement checks

outside the locator: the live route still requires the single-ellipsis provenance, baseline tripwire, staging preflight, durable intent and an at-most-once dispatch, and a human owner authorizes each live round
